blocks.text:
On arrival in Buenos Aires, a private transfer will take you from the international airport to the Four Seasons Buenos Aires hotel (city-view guest room, breakfast included).

The room-category rate is available on request. The hotel is located in Recoleta.

After check-in, you will have free time.

Buenos Aires welcomes visitors with wide avenues, European architecture, green parks and a lively nightlife scene. Avenida 9 de Julio is especially notable for the scale of the city-centre streets and blocks.
